title: Life insurance: apply a mortality / lapse scenario to a contract
description: ACTUS-I LifeInsuranceGpuExecutor.ProjectScenarioBatch. The projection kernel itself knows nothing about scenarios: a scenario is applied by cloning the contract with two fields changed, and the clone is projected as usual (life-project.json). Input: { contract: { extraPremBps, yearsInForce, ... }, scenario: { mortalityShiftBps, lapseMultiplierPct } }. Output: $.adjusted { extraPremBps, yearsInForce } to merge into the contract. The mortality shift is added to extraPremBps and clamped to +-5000. The lapse multiplier is NOT applied to lapse rates: a multiplier other than 100 moves yearsInForce by -(pct - 100) * 0.05 years (never below 0), which moves the contract into another duration bracket of the lapse table. A multiplier of 100 leaves yearsInForce as it is.
